judgments.reason: Perronnet et al. 2018 proposes an integrated EEG-fMRI-NF bimodal feedback concept (XP1-style work); it is listed in the README but doesn't describe this XP2 dataset, which is Lioi et al. 2019.
bioRxiv preprint of the Scientific Data descriptor for this XP2 simultaneous EEG-fMRI motor imagery neurofeedback dataset (30 volunteers); it is listed in the README as the original paper.
judgments.paper_title: Simultaneous MRI-EEG during a motor imagery neurofeedback task: an open access brain imaging dataset for multi-modal data integration

judgments.reason: Paper describes how to build a hybrid EEG-fMRI neurofeedback platform (setup/technical guide), a platform used by the protocol, not the release of this dataset.
judgments.paper_title: How to Build a Hybrid Neurofeedback Platform Combining EEG and fMRI
